prompts:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: an atlas of 16 printable illustrated school subject posters for a French collège website. Create a high-resolution 2048x2048 minimum square image, exact 4 columns x 4 rows regular grid, every cell exactly equal size, square individual poster artwork. No gaps or gutters, no outer margins, no border between cells. Each COLUMN represents ONE subject; every column has FOUR different posters from top to bottom. Flat frontal printed artwork itself, never a photograph or classroom mockup. Colorful sophisticated educational print illustration, vivid gouache/screenprint-inspired style with detailed, recognizable subjects dominating each cell. Rich art suitable to view at 0.8m on a school wall. Minimum text; one short correct heading if helpful, no paragraphs. Avoid frames, shadows, perspective mounting, classrooms, watermarks. Nothing spans multiple cells.
Atlas A. COLUMN 1 Arts plastiques: row1 a beautiful color wheel with paint swatches; row2 an expressive original colorful still-life artwork with fruit and vase; row3 assorted painter tools including brushes palette and paint tubes with layered shapes; row4 an original abstract composition exploring complementary color and collage.
COLUMN 2 Mathématiques: row1 elegant geometric constructions using ruler compass triangles and circles; row2 proportions and tessellated patterns, no formulas; row3 bilateral and rotational symmetry in colorful geometric patterns; row4 geometric solids with cube sphere cylinder cone and pyramid illustrated clearly.
COLUMN 3 Français: row1 literature with an open book, feather pen and imaginative story motifs; row2 theatre with stage curtains and comedy/tragedy masks; row3 writing with handwritten pages, fountain pen, ink and manuscript; row4 a rich library of varied books and warm reading motifs.
COLUMN 4 Allemand: row1 recognizable Brandenburg Gate and Berlin skyline; row2 German cultural architecture including a Bavarian half-timbered street; row3 illustrated simple vocabulary objects with short correct German words such as Buch, Haus, Apfel; row4 German landmarks with a romantic castle and Cologne cathedral.
Exactly 16 distinct square posters; exactly 4x4 grid.
